rca of the issue: Root cause: When admins typed a staff/office_admin name into the manual 'Reference' text field on a student (instead of using /apply?ref=<slug>), the `referrer_user_id` column was never populated. Staff dashboard endpoints (/api/students/me/referrals) filter strictly by `referrer_user_id == user.id`, so those name-only-referenced students were invisible on the employee's own dashboard. Fix (this iteration): (1) new helper `_resolve_referrer_by_name` in routers/students.py does case-insensitive whitespace-tolerant lookup against users with role in (staff, office_admin, super_admin); (2) POST /api/students and PATCH /api/students/{id} auto-populate referrer_user_id + referrer_name from reference; (3) POST /api/public/applications falls back to name lookup when referrer_id is missing; (4) seed.py Case-2 backfill retroactively fixes existing rows on every boot.
